talents.from: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. talents.to: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.
